.DISCUSSION...Vicinity showers end late this afternoon or early
evening with dry conditions through the weekend. The afternoon
minimum RHs will be trending lower over the next few days, at
around 50% this afternoon, 40% Saturday and to around 35% both 
Sunday and Monday. Overnight RH recoveries are expected to remain 
very high this weekend and into next week, generally ranging from
80-90%. Winds remain Northerly today and Saturday, becoming
Southerly Sunday and Monday.
